title: An integral degree-three Gersten counterexample
summary: We construct a two-dimensional ramified regular local ring A in mixed characteristic $`(0,5)`$ for which the integral map $`K_3(A)\to K_3(\mathop{\mathrm{Frac}}\nolimits A)`$ has nonzero kernel. This gives a negative answer to the unrestricted integral Gersten conjecture.

review.reason: Builds a local ring giving a negative answer to the unrestricted integral Gersten conjecture.
